text:
Lennon Park: hey folks! Lennon here — super excited to join the inference team. :wave: I’m based in SF, love puzzles, and will bring my sourdough starter to the next IRL bake-off if there is one. also attaching a picture of my dog for science: https://imgur.com/a/exampledog :dog:

Maya Chen: welcome Lennon!! :tada: dog is adorable. what’s the pup’s name?

Lennon Park: thanks Maya! her name’s Mochi. she’s partial to lap naps and stolen sandwiches. :blush:

Gabe Ortiz: hi Lennon — welcome to Redwood! if you’re into puzzles, we have a weekly lunchtime chess/catan-ish crowd on Thursdays. also +1 for sourdough.

Sam Pizza: Mochi!! also hi welcome. we judge bake skills harshly but fairly. :judge: where in SF are you? plenty of good lunch recs.

Lennon Park: I’m in the Mission. recommendations appreciated — I like ramen and mom-and-pop sandwich shops.

Toni (People Ops): welcome, Lennon — excited to have you. quick FYI: badge and T-shirt pickup is at 2pm today in the lobby. I’ll DM you the desk map. :smile:

Recruiter Bot: Lennon Park joined #new-hires (Profile: lennon.park@redwood.com) — Welcome package sent via email.

Rafa: welcome!! quick poll: should we make Mochi the unofficial mascot of the bake-off? options: 1) yes, give Mochi a tiny chef hat 2) yes, but only if Mochi tastes the sourdough 3) no, we prefer impartial judges (aka the plants)

Lennon Park: poll vote = 1 for the hat. :chef: also curious — is there a slack channel for puzzle nerds or baking tips?

Maya Chen: there’s #random-bakes and #puzzle-club. I’ll ping you an invite to a small puzzles thread.

Gabe Ortiz: also, FYI the team usually meets in-person Fridays for lunch. stop by the infra table and say hi.

Sam Pizza: ditto — welcome again. and if you want a ramen rec: try Mensho on 16th.

Lennon Park: saved! thanks everyone — looking forward to meeting y’all in person. Mochi is already planning her chef hat outfit. :dog::chef:
